title: Set 151

sentences.ko: 내일 당장 그만두겠다는 건 아닌데, 연말까지 아무것도 안 바뀌면 그만둘 것 같아. 5년 뒤에도 똑같은 상사 욕이나 하고 있는 사람이 되고 싶지는 않거든.
sentences.text: I'm not saying I'm going to quit tomorrow, but if nothing changes by the end of the year, I think I'm done. I just don't want to be the one still complaining about the same boss five years from now.

alts.text: Not like I'm quitting tomorrow or anything, but if stuff's still the same by the end of the year, I'm kinda done. I don't wanna be the one still griping about the same boss five years from now.

I am not suggesting that I will resign tomorrow, but if nothing has changed by the end of the year, I believe I will be ready to leave. I simply do not wish to be the person who is still complaining about the same manager five years from now.

sentences.note: **I'm not saying** ~, but 은 내 말이 지나치게 들리지 않게 미리 선을 긋는 말이에요. **I'm done** 은 이제 더는 못 하겠다, 손 떼겠다는 뜻이고, casual의 **griping** 은 투덜대며 불평하는 거예요.

sentences.ko: 아니 아니, 회사 괜찮아, 다 괜찮아. 어제 뭐 보다가 너무 늦게 자서 목소리가 피곤하게 들리는 거야, 그게 다야. 그나저나 허리는 좀 어때?
sentences.text: Yeah, no, work's good, everything's good. I just sound tired because I stayed up too late watching something, that's all. Anyway, how's your back doing?

alts.text: Nah, work's fine, it's all good. I just sound wiped 'cause I was up way too late watching something, that's all. Anyway, how's the back?
No, work is going well, and everything is fine. I only sound tired because I stayed up too late watching something. In any case, how is your back?

sentences.note: **Yeah, no** 는 앞말을 받아 주면서 아니라고 부정할 때 원어민이 자주 쓰는 말버릇이에요. **stayed up too late** 는 너무 늦게까지 안 잤다는 뜻이고, casual의 **wiped** 는 녹초가 됐다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

sentences.ko: 고양이한테 비싼 침대를 하나 사 줬는데, 근처에도 안 가더라. 근데 그 침대 들어 있던 상자에서는 하루 종일 자. 40달러 그냥 날린 거지 뭐.
sentences.text: We got the cat one of those fancy beds, and she won't even go near it, but she'll sleep in the box it came in all day. So I guess that's forty bucks we're never getting back.

alts.text: Got the cat this fancy bed and she won't go anywhere near it, but she'll sleep in the box it came in all day. Guess that's forty bucks down the drain.
We purchased one of those expensive beds for our cat, and she will not even approach it, yet she will sleep in the box it came in all day. I suppose that is forty dollars we will never recover.

sentences.note: **won't even go near it** 는 가까이 가려고도 안 한다는 뜻이에요. **bucks** 는 달러를 편하게 부르는 말이고, casual의 **down the drain** 은 돈이 허공으로 날아갔다는 표현이에요.

sentences.ko: 정말 미안한데 나 이제 가 봐야 돼. 베이비시터한테 10시까지 들어간다고 했거든. 또 늦으면 다시는 우리 애들 안 봐 줄 것 같아. 그러면 우리 진짜 큰일 나.
sentences.text: I'm really sorry, but I've got to head out. I told the babysitter we'd be back by ten, and if I'm late again I don't think she'll ever watch the kids for us again, and then we're really stuck.

alts.text: Sorry, I gotta go. Told the babysitter we'd be home by ten, and if I'm late again she's never gonna watch the kids for us, and then we're totally stuck.

I do apologize, but I must leave now. I told the babysitter we would return by ten, and if I am late once more, I doubt she will ever look after the children for us again, which would leave us in a very difficult position.

sentences.note: **head out** 은 자리를 뜨다, 나가 보다라는 뜻이에요. **watch the kids** 는 아이들을 봐 주다이고, **we're really stuck** 은 꼼짝없이 곤란해진다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 앱에는 우리 음식이 배달됐다고 나오는데, 현관 앞에 웬 남의 장 본 게 있어. 우유랑 달걀이랑 엄청 큰 고양이 사료 한 포대. 좀 마음이 안 좋아, 어디선가 누가 이걸 기다리고 있을 거잖아?
sentences.text: So the app says our food was delivered, but there's just somebody else's groceries on the porch, like milk and eggs and a huge bag of cat food. And I kind of feel bad, because someone out there's waiting for this stuff too, right?

alts.text: App says our food got delivered, but it's just someone else's groceries on the porch, like milk, eggs, and this giant bag of cat food. Kinda feel bad, 'cause somebody's waiting on this stuff too, you know?

According to the app, our food was delivered, but there are only someone else's groceries on the porch, including milk, eggs, and a very large bag of cat food. I feel rather bad about it, because someone else is surely waiting for these items as well.

sentences.note: **the app says** 는 앱에 그렇게 나온다는 뜻으로, 화면에 뜬 내용을 말할 때 그대로 써요. **I kind of feel bad** 는 좀 미안하다, 마음이 쓰인다는 말이고, casual의 **waiting on** 은 무언가가 오기를 기다린다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 1번 formal 의 I believe I will be finished 는 일에서 손을 뗀다는 I'm done 의 뜻이 흐려져서, 그만두겠다는 뜻이 살도록 고쳤습니다
1번 한국어 나는 그만할 것 같아 를 회사 얘기에 맞게 그만둘 것 같아 로 다듬었습니다
